name: kitchen-tools
description: Chef Intelligence: portable kitchen skills and boilerplates, with optional tested calculation tools and CulinaryOS handoffs.

interface.longDescription: The portable brains and boilerplates of CulinaryOS Interagency. Describe a task, load one relevant original skill and ask only for the next necessary input. Use any AI accepting text; optional MCP adds tested calculations and clean menus. CulinaryOS and Ross Manor remain separately authorized adapters. AI-provider requirements apply.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to use Open Kitchen Toolkit, one step at a time.
Help me cost my menu and check it against my own margin targets.
Help me organize my recipes and make their units consistent.
